responsibility: This implementation module provides the concrete ARRAY OF CHAR command-line access routines for GNU Modula-2 by wrapping the low-level UnixArgs argc/argv runtime hooks. It reads the process argument vector returned by GetArgV, copies a selected argument into a caller buffer with ASCII nul termination, and reports the number of arguments via GetArgC, making it the basic argv-to-Modula-2 string bridge beneath the String-based SArgs interface.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Args pair: unlike Args.def, which only declares the API, this file imports UnixArgs and ASCII and implements GetArg/Narg by reading argc/argv and copying nul-terminated argument text into caller buffers.
